connector.name: MCP by uservane.com
connector.registryDescription: Query NPS, CSAT, CES, and PMF survey results, responses, and links for your UserVane project.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.uservane.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.uservane, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.1 bearer token from UserVane (WorkOS AuthKit). Obtained automatically by MCP clients via the advertised OAuth flow; no API key.
